entries.description: OpenSSF Scorecard - Security health metrics for Open Source
entries.proposed_fit: Repository supply-chain practice signals
entries.limitations: Score is evidence for review, not security certification

entries.name: Harden-Runner
entries.description: Harden-Runner is a CI/CD security agent that works like an EDR for GitHub Actions runners. It monitors network, file, and process activity and integrates with Secure Registry to apply package cooldowns and block known compromised packages.
entries.proposed_fit: Evaluate runner isolation and egress controls
entries.limitations: Open action and hosted/premium telemetry terms differ

entries.name: Renovate
entries.description: Home of the Mend Renovate CLI: Cross-platform Dependency Automation by Mend.io
entries.proposed_fit: Automated dependency update proposals
entries.limitations: Review lockfiles/tests; updates should not auto-deploy production

entries.name: Semgrep
entries.description: Lightweight static analysis for many languages. Find bug variants with patterns that look like source code.
entries.proposed_fit: Static analysis for app/service source
entries.limitations: Engine, rules and hosted/premium analysis use different licenses

entries.name: Bandit
entries.description: Bandit is a tool designed to find common security issues in Python code.
entries.proposed_fit: Python security linting for owned code
entries.limitations: Heuristics; review findings rather than silent baselines

entries.name: TruffleHog
entries.description: Find, verify, and analyze leaked credentials
entries.proposed_fit: Alternative secret discovery for owned repos/artifacts
entries.limitations: Credential verification can contact services; use controlled scope

entries.name: OWASP ZAP
entries.description: The ZAP by Checkmarx Core project
entries.proposed_fit: Authenticated web/API checks on owned test deployments
entries.limitations: Test against isolated authorized environments; protect session data

entries.name: MobSF
entries.description: Mobile Security Framework (MobSF) is an automated, all-in-one mobile application (Android/iOS/Windows) pen-testing, malware analysis and security assessment framework capable of performing static and dynamic analysis.
entries.proposed_fit: Android/iOS package analysis
entries.limitations: Reports need review; test-built artifacts and secrets remain sensitive

entries.name: Frida
entries.description: Main repo for hosting release binaries
entries.proposed_fit: Instrument our native apps to validate security boundaries
entries.limitations: Testing tool, not a protection shipped to end users

entries.name: scrcpy
entries.description: Display and control your Android device
entries.proposed_fit: Android device interaction for privacy/capture acceptance
entries.limitations: Not a surveillance defense; device-owner-authorized tests

entries.name: MASVS
entries.description: The OWASP MASVS (Mobile Application Security Verification Standard) is the industry standard for mobile app security.
entries.proposed_fit: Mobile privacy/storage/authentication requirements
entries.limitations: Open documentation rather than a runtime library

entries.name: MASTG
entries.description: The OWASP Mobile Application Security Testing Guide (MASTG) is a comprehensive manual for mobile app security testing and reverse engineering. It describes technical processes for verifying the OWASP Mobile Security Weakness Enumeration (MASWE) weaknesses, which are in alignment with the OWASP MASVS.
entries.proposed_fit: Repeatable iOS/Android privacy and security test cases
entries.limitations: Guidance/test code licenses can differ

entries.name: ASVS
entries.description: Application Security Verification Standard
entries.proposed_fit: Web/API verification requirements
entries.limitations: Map to concrete endpoints and evidence

entries.name: OWASP Cheat Sheets
entries.description: The OWASP Cheat Sheet Series was created to provide a concise collection of high value information on specific application security topics.
entries.proposed_fit: Implementation guidance for auth, WebViews, files and sessions
entries.limitations: Verify applicability to current platform and architecture

entries.name: KES
entries.description: [Deprecated] Key Encryption Server
entries.proposed_fit: Evaluate server-side object-key management only if still maintained
entries.limitations: Not vault/E2EE key management; inspect archive/license status

entries.name: Vector
entries.description: A high-performance observability data pipeline.
entries.proposed_fit: Filter/redact logs before they leave a host
entries.limitations: Configure actual transforms; never log private payloads then call it minimized

entries.name: OpenTelemetry Collector
entries.description: OpenTelemetry Collector
entries.proposed_fit: Explicit filtering/redaction for selected telemetry
entries.limitations: Disable sensitive attributes and uncontrolled exporters

entries.name: Pino
entries.description: 🌲 super fast, all natural json logger
entries.proposed_fit: Structured application logs with field redaction
entries.limitations: Field rules must cover nested/secrets; no private message bodies

entries.name: OpenDP
entries.description: The core library of differential privacy algorithms powering the OpenDP Project.
entries.proposed_fit: Research privacy-preserving community aggregate statistics
entries.limitations: Requires a validated statistical design and disclosure thresholds

entries.name: Google differential privacy
entries.description: Google's differential privacy libraries.
entries.proposed_fit: Alternative vetted mechanisms for aggregate analysis
entries.limitations: No individual profiling; contribution/budget accounting needed

entries.name: PySyft
entries.description: Perform data science on data that remains in someone else's server
entries.proposed_fit: Study permissioned analysis across community data
entries.limitations: Heavy later research; not a reason to collect private activity

entries.name: Tink
entries.description: Tink is a multi-language, cross-platform, open source library that provides cryptographic APIs that are secure, easy to use correctly, and hard(er) to misuse.
entries.proposed_fit: Established application-level crypto APIs if a real gap remains
entries.limitations: Not an alternate Matrix or vault protocol
